mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in tightening periods than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which signals a potential economic downturn and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to potential economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of industrial production decline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when both housing starts increase and unemployment rate decreases (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in low inflation periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail and food services sales signals increased consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially in a low unemployment regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when retail sales increase in low unemployment periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
